rules.instruction: Name the shock, outcome, population, and horizon before describing the tool.
Explain the obstacle and the particular operation that addresses it.
Make theory objects determine empirical tasks and section handoffs.
Compare papers by object, assumption, identification, or adjustment margin.
Carry a defined economic object into the next sentence before adding a new one.
Use economic actors and choices to explain a mechanism.
Give each paragraph a claim, its reason or evidence, and an economic interpretation.
End with the unresolved object that motivates the next empirical operation.
Define agents, choices, timing, indices, and units before equations.
Distinguish general valuation from stronger restrictions for response recovery.
Introduce a restriction at the step that requires it and explain its economic role.
Motivate a result, name its assumptions, then interpret and use it.
Explain optimized choices and why their separate local contribution vanishes.
Use a simple example to explain the mechanism, not to silently prove the general case.
Explain an entry and a scalar round before interpreting an operator.
Distinguish inversion, equilibrium uniqueness, convergence, and steady-state uniqueness.
State what a normalization fixes and what it does not identify.
Organize sources by the economic objects and links they measure.
Disclose geography, sample timing, measurement differences, and missing support.
Interpret a map or distribution through magnitudes, mechanisms, and the design question.
Keep economic representation, statistical identification, and level normalization separate.
Define the observation, remaining variation, regressors, and identifying restriction.
Do not interpret a composite fixed effect as a uniquely identified economic primitive.
Distinguish cross-sectional ordering from aggregate common level changes.
Separate accounting identities, behavioral restrictions, and equilibrium conditions.
State uncertainty, clustering, weights, and what is held fixed.
Lead with the economic result rather than a tour of columns.
Distinguish group averages, proportional gains, currency gains, and within-group differences.
Organize checks by the assumptions or threats they address.
Keep failures, discrepancies, and sensitive magnitudes visible.
Report separately whether sign, shape, ordering, and magnitude survive.
Distinguish matched moments from independent or untargeted comparisons.
Do not equate non-rejection, correlation, or good fit with general causal validity.
Define the shock, baseline, closure, welfare metric, and extra structure.
Label estimated parameters, calibrated parameters, assumptions, and model predictions separately.
Separate infinitesimal valuation, finite approximation, and exact finite computation.
Do not treat differently defined residuals or elasticities as interchangeable.
Explain which object or adjustment margin an extension changes.
Return to the opening question and preserve the claim's boundaries.
Move navigation and secondary detail out of the main argument without hiding essential conditions.
Make outcome, units, sample, transformations, weights, and uncertainty recoverable from an exhibit.
Label observed versus predicted series, normalization, support, and scales.
Keep geographic interpretation separate from classification, missingness, and denominators.
Choose explanatory diagrams or formal detail according to the reader's task.
Distinguish reduced-form forces from independently identified microfoundations.
